schedule.title: Event Schedule
schedule.description: Check out the complete VRTon activities program. Discover workshops, virtual reality demonstrations, technical talks, and special events for Teletón Chile.

opening.name: Opening Ceremony
opening.description: Official welcome to the VRTon event with organizer presentations and program overview.

talk-teleton.name: Talk about Teletón
talk-teleton.description: DannySmile gives us a talk about how Teletón helps change the lives of many people in Chile.

talk-medic.name: Medical Talk
talk-medic.description: Doctors and physiotherapists from the Teletón Aysén Institute talk to us about rehabilitation and the impact of Teletón on health.

talk-guide.name: Guided Tour
talk-guide.description: DannySmile gives us a guided tour of the Teletón Aysén Institute, explaining its different areas and its IRL value.

games-coliseo.name: Coliseum Roleplay
games-coliseo.description: Join the Cult of Secrets and the Black Steeds in an immersive roleplay experience.

games-zumbaton.name: Zumbaton
games-zumbaton.description: Zumba and dance class for all attendees, led by the host team in collaboration with institute instructors.

games-triatlon.name: Virtual Triathlon
games-triatlon.description: Participate in a series of games and competitions and win trophies for the map!

games-race.name: Wheelchair Race
games-race.description: Who says you can't compete in wheelchairs? Show your skill and speed!

show-singer1.name: Live Singer
show-singer1.description: First session of shows and artistic performances from the community.

show-singer2.name: Gianma Live Show
show-singer2.description: Live Salsa and Latin music singer.

rifa.name: Raffle
rifa.description: Raffle of prizes and gifts among event attendees to encourage participation and enthusiasm.

closing_ceremony.name: Closing Ceremony
closing_ceremony.description: Official event closing with acknowledgments, final fundraising results, and next steps.

maid_cafe.name: Maid Café
maid_cafe.description: The Mononita cafe opens its doors in a Maid Café themed space so all attendees can enjoy delicious drinks and desserts in a cozy and fun atmosphere.

after_party.name: After Party
after_party.description: Post-event party with music, dancing, and socializing for all attendees.
